nyxid.name: NyxID
nyxid.pitch: Connect AI agents to any API, anywhere. Securely.
nyxid.one_liner: Connect any AI agent to your real stack — without ever handing the agent your credentials.
nyxid.wedge: open-source Agent Connectivity Gateway: credential injection, MCP auto-wrap, per-agent isolation, and Credential Nodes so agents call real APIs without seeing raw keys
nyxid.image_gradient: deep violet #5E00F5 in the upper-left to soft lavender #A672FB in the center to dusty pink lower-right
image_compositions: a single frosted glass torus ring floats subtly behind the typography in the lower-right corner as quiet visual accent, partially cropped
a tall frosted glass monolith slab tilts behind the typography in the lower-right corner, edge-lit with subtle inner refraction, partially cropped
three floating frosted-glass shards of varying sizes drift behind the typography in the lower-right corner, each shard catching gradient light, partially cropped
a 4x4 grid of small frosted glass cubes floats behind the typography in the lower-right corner, each cube slightly rotated and catching ambient light, partially cropped
a single frosted glass sphere with a soft inner caustic glow rests behind the typography in the lower-right corner, partially cropped
a thin sharp beam of cool violet light refracts through a small floating glass prism behind the typography in the lower-right corner, partially cropped

ornn.name: Ornn
ornn.pitch: Skills-as-a-service for agents — manage, auto-generate, and call agent skills as simply as an API.
ornn.one_liner: Your all-in-one platform to manage your skills, auto-generate skills, and use agent skills as simple as calling an API.
ornn.wedge: agent-facing skill-lifecycle API: agents call Ornn over HTTP or MCP to search, pull, install, execute, build, upload, and share versioned skill packages
ornn.release_cta: Open https://ornn.chrono-ai.fun and try the new flow.
